question: Under either answer to B194, does a distance read from the allowed states give an order with nothing skipped and two independent orders: implication bases (order, dimension read from betweenness), NAE thread, weave, chain grid, knot tree (pair patterns, betweenness, order-only gap graph levels, transfer gaps)?

definitions.disagreement count: allowed states in which two distinctions differ
definitions.gap neighbour: no w with tau(o,w) < tau(o,v) and tau(w,v) < tau(o,v) (strict)
definitions.order dimension: Dushnik-Miller two-test by Golumbic implication classes; three = test fails and a verified realizer of three
definitions.transfer gap: log_3(lambda_0 / |lambda_1|), lambda_1 the largest modulus below the top

forbidden_inputs: Changing bases, readings, predictions or decision rules after seeing registered results
cheapest_meaningful_control: The knot tree (exponential levels) and bare S_3 (the betweenness route reads nothing).

predictions.I3: comparability from betweenness exact on seven; none on bare S_3
predictions.I4: order up to reversal on seven, not bare S_3
predictions.I5: dimension <= 2 on chain and four two-way orders; 3 on 3x3x3 and S_3 with bottom/top (realizer verified)
predictions.K1: all four patterns on thread, weave, chain grid
predictions.K2: no strict betweenness on thread and through chain-grid starts
predictions.K3: chain grid degrees 8 / 2, levels as listed
predictions.K6: tree: gap graph = co-knot graph, levels 1, 2, 4, 8, 16
predictions.K7: chain-grid gap within 0.01 of 0.3691 at width 12, deviation shrinking
predictions.K8: weave gap falls with width, gap(12)/gap(6) < 0.7

decision_rules.each prediction: holds or fails as stated in the pre-registration

stop_rule: One run; A97 and A98 status; referee hand-off; report.
